immersive_horse_riding.config.title: Immersive Horse Riding
immersive_horse_riding.config.smooth_acc: The horse gradually speeds up and slows down instead of instantly reaching full speed.
immersive_horse_riding.config.accelerati: How quickly the horse reaches full speed.
immersive_horse_riding.config.decelerati: How quickly the horse slows down when you release the forward key.
immersive_horse_riding.config.reverse_sp: How fast the horse walks backwards. Set to 0 to disable walking backwards.
immersive_horse_riding.config.turning.de: The horse turns with the strafe keys at a limited speed instead of instantly facing where you look.
immersive_horse_riding.config.turn_speed: How many degrees the horse can turn per tick.
immersive_horse_riding.config.camera_ste: When enabled, the horse turns toward where you look and movement keys are relative to the camera. When disabled, the camera moves freely and the horse is steered with the strafe keys. Requires Key Turning.
immersive_horse_riding.config.look_with_: In third person camera mods, the rider looks where the camera looks instead of turning toward the direction the horse moves. Requires Key Turning and has no effect with Camera Steering.
immersive_horse_riding.config.camera_bob: Bob the camera up and down while riding.
immersive_horse_riding.config.third_pers: Also bob the camera while riding in third person, including third person camera mods. Requires Camera Bobbing.
immersive_horse_riding.config.head_bob_i: How strongly the camera bobs while riding.
immersive_horse_riding.config.head_bob_f: How fast the camera bobs while riding.
immersive_horse_riding.config.horse_head: Replace the vanilla horse head bobbing animation with a configurable one.
How strongly the horse's head bobs while moving.
How fast the horse's head bobs while moving.
